proposal.reason: Main change is CI workflow execution logic: `.github/workflows/build-artifactory-ppu.yml`, `source-sanity.yml`, and `pccl-daily-full.yml` now resolve `t-head/pccl-tests` by matching branch with fallback to `main`, propagate resolved SHA/branch across jobs, and add authenticated `docker/login-action` before image pull to prevent unauthenticated pull failures. `ci` takes priority because this is test/build workflow selection and run orchestration behavior, while `.github/xtest/artifact_cache.py` and `test_workflow_contract.py` are supporting CI contract updates (`FIXTURE_RUNNER_REVISION`) aligned to that workflow change, not an independent module policy change.
